blind.description: A straight section of masonry wall constructed from stacked rectangular stone bricks with light mortar lines, topped by a slightly overhanging two-piece stone coping slab. The stone has a weathered, dark olive-grey to brown crypt-like texture. All surfaces are solid, cleanly modeled, and sit directly and flat on the ground plane without an artificial base.
blind.from_above: A narrow elongated rectangle divided crosswise into two rectangular stone cap segments.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.3 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 7.5 ft tall); approximately 3.5 to 4 ft wide and about 1 ft thick.
